name: Forgotten Realms
description: The Sword Coast and the wider continent of Faerûn: bustling cities such as Waterdeep and Baldur's Gate, ancient ruins, and a crowded pantheon of active gods. The default setting of fifth-edition adventures, with room for every kind of story.

name: Eberron
description: A world recovering from the Last War, where lightning rails and airships run on bound elementals. Pulp action and noir intrigue between rival nations, dragonmarked houses and secret societies.

name: Greyhawk
description: The original campaign world of Oerth, centred on the Free City of Greyhawk. Classic dungeon delving, scheming wizards and morally grey factions.

name: Ravenloft
description: The Domains of Dread, pocket realms in the Shadowfell, each ruled and imprisoned by its Darklord. Investigation, dread and tragedy rather than glory.

name: Dark Sun
description: The desert world of Athas, ruined by defiling magic and ruled by sorcerer-kings. Water is scarce, metal is rare and survival comes first.

name: Planescape
description: Sigil, the City of Doors, sits at the centre of the multiverse, where philosophical factions argue about the nature of reality. Portals lead to every plane of existence.

name: Spelljammer
description: Ships sail through Wildspace and the Astral Sea between crystal spheres. Swashbuckling voyages, strange crews and pirates among the stars.

name: Dragonlance
description: The world of Krynn, torn by the War of the Lance. Dragon armies, legendary heroes and a struggle between good, evil and neutrality.

name: Exandria
description: The world of Tal'Dorei and Wildemount, shaped by a calamitous war between gods. Rival empires, frontier towns and dunamancy magic.

name: Theros
description: A land inspired by Greek myth, where gods depend on the devotion of mortals. Heroes chase glory and destiny under the eyes of the pantheon.

name: Ravnica
description: A city that covers an entire world, governed by ten rival guilds. Politics, crime and investigation among towering spires and crowded streets.

name: Strixhaven
description: A university of magic with five rival colleges. Exams, clubs, rivalries and a mystery beneath the campus.

name: Mystara
description: The Known World of the classic Basic and Expert rules: a patchwork of nations from the Grand Duchy of Karameikos to the Hollow World beneath.
